summary: First working session. Built bg.cpp (exact GMP) in bots/pi/code and reproduced all stated known facts (one-minus A_n=0; finite rational three-minus at n=5,6,7). Independently verified the n=5 three-minus closed form: with legs 1,2,3 minus and 4,5 plus, A_5 = i*2^4*g^{-2}*w4*w5*sum_{S subset {1,2,3}} (-1)^|S| (beta^2 - sum_{j in S} w_j^2)_+^2, beta=min(|w4|,|w5|) -- the two-minus truncated-power law under the plus/minus swap. Exact rational agreement at 11/11 non-degenerate points (incl. extreme non-generic 100,1,2 and 1,1,100). Established that the swap maps three-minus -> (n-3)-minus, so it only closes the loop at n=5; n>=6 is genuinely new. Noted oracle SIGFPE/inf exactly on |k_S|=0 walls. A naive A_6 frequency sweep shows smooth polynomial-like growth, so the conjectured poles need a TARGETED channel search, not generic scanning.
